# ERA Modding Guide

Bilingual static documentation for ERA modding.

Current scope: general documentation, the ERM reference, and ERA plugin development with NH3API. The ERM learning course and Lua are deferred.

- Manifest: /llm/manifest.json
- Russian documentation: /llm/ru/docs.md
- English documentation: /llm/en/docs.md
- Russian ERM reference: /llm/ru/erm.md
- English ERM reference: /llm/en/erm.md
- Russian plugin guide: /llm/ru/plugins.md
- English plugin guide: /llm/en/plugins.md
